Tree.doc: The editable tree the browser shows, and which editor mode opens a file.

Files.doc: Read, write, create, rename and delete one file inside the root.

Folders.doc:
Create, rename and delete a folder inside the root.

A folder that holds something this tool cannot see (a `.php` file, a
dotfile, an excluded folder) is never moved or deleted: the screen must
never take away more than it showed.

facade_doc_extra:
This class is the entry point the controller calls; the work lives in
`FileManager\Root` (the three walls: extension, realpath, exclusions),
`FileManager\Tree` (the listing), `FileManager\Files` and
`FileManager\Folders`. Split in WP7d, code moved verbatim.
